name: wir
description: WIR – Das Mitarbeiterportal (Schloss & Gut Liebenberg / DKB STIFTUNG)

scripts.setup: npm run build -w @wir/db && npm run migrate -w @wir/db && npm run seed -w @wir/db
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @wir/db && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @wir/api" "npm run dev -w @wir/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wir/db && npm run build -w @wir/api && npm run build -w @wir/web
